title: hwbench topology, version 1
description: Where each server is, given to hwbench with -t/--topology: the location of the server whose serial it finds. Every server is either in 'topology', a fixed hierarchy of 6 levels from the country to the height in the rack, or in 'extra', a place this hierarchy does not describe; a serial appears only once in the whole file, which this schema cannot check: run tools/topology_check.py. See documentation/topology.md.

version.description: The version of the format: 1 for this schema.

extra.description: The servers out of the hierarchy, by the free text naming their place, like 'Secret Lab 1'.

Country.description: The countries, by their ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, like 'FR', each holding its datacenters. The name '' stands for a country not known.

Datacenter.description: The datacenters of a country, like 'PA99', each holding its datahalls. The name '' stands for a datacenter not known.

Datahall.description: The halls of a datacenter, like 'DH2', each holding its rooms. The name '' stands for a datahall not known, or a datacenter without datahalls.

Room.description: The rooms of a datahall, like 'Room 1' or 'Cage 1', shown as is: the name holds its kind of room, each holding its racks. The name '' stands for a room not known, or a datahall without rooms.

Rack.description: The racks of a room, like 'A12', shown as 'Rack A12': the name does not hold 'Rack', each holding its heights. The name '' stands for a rack not known.

U.description: The heights in a rack, like '23', shown as 'U23': the name does not hold 'U', the lowest height of a server spanning several, each holding the serials of the servers at that height: several for the nodes of a multi-node chassis. The name '' stands for a height not known.

serials.description: The serial numbers of the servers, as the DMI of each server gives them (/sys/devices/virtual/dmi/id/product_serial), without the spaces at their ends: the one of the node, not of the chassis, compared with case.

name.description: A text without spaces at its ends.

level_name.description: The name of a level of the hierarchy, without spaces at its ends, or '' when the level is not known.
